title: Case deadline and output bound fail with descendants and large output
symptom: 1 s and 3 s deadlines returned after 20-21 s; 300 MB output peaked at 578 MiB
trigger: A bound command whose descendant keeps stdout or stderr open, or that writes a lot
expected: The run returns by its deadline, descendants are stopped, and retained output stays within the bound while reading
actual: Only the direct child is killed; readers wait for EOF and collect everything before truncating
impact: A case can hang chough or exhaust memory
source: Review finding E, reproduced 2026-10-31 against main f19823d

notes.text: status: open -> verified. Fixed in bbd9f04 (bounded runner: per-stream caps while reading, process-group stop at the deadline or 2 s after exit, abandoned readers); regression cases TC-cli-0045 to TC-cli-0047 and the recorded reproduction rerun pass on macOS arm64.
